column4:
I lived and worked on my families farm in the southern colonies with my family. I was the youngest brother of 8 brothers and 6 sisters. During the war before France came to our aid and turned the tide my farm became a battle field for the deep reaching British invaders at first it was just the occasional gunshot in the distance worrying mama but soon they were asking for money and supplies and when we couldn't pay anymore my father ended up staying later and later into the nights to protect from the British looting. Until eventually he asked my brothers to help as well. They watched the house day and night at, least one person watching from the hay house at all times. One day as British soldiers marched across our fields my brother was shot they must have thought he was a union soldier, he was holding a rifle standing by the window and once that first shot was fired my brothers and pap started firing back taking down the group of men who fired shot my brother. But after that moment my pa knew we were officially enemies of the crown and he said we had to go. my mom, my sisters, and me loaded the wagon while my brothers and pa fired at the British soldiers approaching the farm they were gonna come after they repelled the attackers meet us in empire city my father handed me a 5 shot pistol and told me to protect my mama and sisters while we were apart, but that he'd see us real soon. But as we gazed at our home shrinking in the distance we watched British troops knock down the door of our home and as it disappeared over the horizon our home was now a blaze. None of my brothers made it out same with my pa. 

My sisters mom and I did manage to hop train to empire city and after we got setup there, it was tough and we were in a rough part of town. Running a con here or rigged dice game there was just how you made your rent. and eventually I made a big score that could set my mom and sisters to be comfortable for a good long time, but I also put a target on my back while doing it, I left empire city only a few months after getting there and drifted on the roads and tracks of the north for a few years. but now I'm back I feel the call of my new home and I've heard that my enemies are less intent on killing me if not all together disbanded.

Sent to Arcania by his village, one of many connected to a symbiotic insect swarm, to start setting up a foothold for the swarm in the New World to spread its influence.

Not because he's the best for the job - he was nominated just so, being considered a bit of a troublemaker, he won't mess up his family's place on the social ladder, and even if he fails, someone better suited can be sent later.

So far he hasn't had much luck recruiting anyone during the journey, but he's more in it out of curiosity rather than for the task. Possible that he knows why he was selected.

Luard is a High Elf Draconic Bloodline Sorcerer. He comes from a long line of elven aristocracy, the Faranells. His family is renowned for their skills in the arcane arts, all of them becoming some sort of famous wizard. This was not the same for Luard. At a young age, he had great difficulty in learning about magic and showcased poor mastery over the art, resulting him receiving great disappointment and scorn from his family. It was only after reaching the age of 21 did Luard receive answers to his conundrum. Learning about magic was alien to him because he already had magic woven into his very being. After suddenly summoning a bubble of acid during a stressful session of trying to learn Mage Hand, Luard became known to his Black Dragon heritage. Emboldened by this newfound power, Luard chose to leave his family's ancestral lands and move to newer frontiers. He chose to travel to Empire City, learn all about his strange new powers and the world at large, determined to prove his family's past prejudices against him wrong and to carve out an entire new legacy around his new name of Dragonheart.

One of the many war orphans that exist in this time, Meorhys arrived at the Empire City 7 months ago, eager to start a new life with what little she has. But it's hard to survive in a city that has more people than it has luck to spare. She struggled to find a proper job for herself. She slept in alleyways, stole food rations, and pickpocketed travelers to survive. 

Eventually, she found her way to a Thieve's Guild, where she took part in odd jobs and contracts to earn coins for her meals. In one of her excursions just 6 weeks ago, she came close to death - or maybe she died, she's really not sure. But when she came to the next day, in the ruins of a temple of some god she didn't know about, she could feel the dead, tingling under her skin with powers new to her. She was confused at first, unsure of what to make of the souls that seem tethered to her own. But in the cold of the dense city, in the damp stone buildings and the solitude she found herself in, she's come to see them as a welcome companion.

Abandoned at birth, Ellie grew up in an orphanage. She became best friends with a half-orc man, and they both lived in the orphanage for about 10 years. One day, the half-orc was killed in a tragic carriage accident. Ellie mourned his death, and sought out the person who had been driving the carriage. Ellie had dreamed of being a queen since she was very young, but after swindling a courier, she found a piece of mail from a lord of her town. She found out that her friend's death was not an accident, and the lord had deliberately ran him over. She brought this evidence was brought to court, but the judge found the lord not guilty, saying the evidence was doctored. She later saw the lord handing money to the judge. Her vision of royalty was destroyed, and her dreams shattered. She moved to Empire City 10 years later, and she has been living in a small inn (if there is any) for 3 months.

Tayssel-Dawn, a Tabaxi Bard (Eloquence? Maybe?? Will read trough all the Colleges a bit more in depth later) in his early 30s from the southern lands (Mexico? If it exists and is a place we are allowed to be from? I am Mexican so it's what makes sense to me but I'm willing to adapt.). Raised by a carpenter who specialized in the creation and maintenance of musical instruments, he learned the intricacies of their builds from a young age, and developed a strong love for the performing arts.

In a better time, perhaps in a better world, he may have chosen the path of a traveling musician, letting fate and his own whims draw the path of what could have been a wondrous journey, but instead, it was the threads of war that eventualy pulled him to Empire City. He has a growing fascination for the advancement of technology and its application in the musical arcane arts. (I assume thats possible based on the steampunk setting? I have ideas for interesting instruments for him but I would ask the DMs what the limitations of this world are. Perhaps one of his personal goals is to find, or even help create, complex musical instruments infused with powerful magic.). 

A caring soul that has been somewhat jaded by the state of the world, his friendliness, natural charm and honesty makes people trust him quickly, and even rely on him. Hes the kind of person who forges really strong bonds, and having experienced a lot of loss along the way, a silent grief weighs heavily on his heart. 

He believes in artistic expression as a powerful tool for communities to make their voices heard, but to him, the inherent beauty of music will always matter most. Hes a deep believer that life must be enjoyed above anythin else, that no matter how dire a situation may be, a soul will rot away if its not allowed to take a rest from time to time.

(There's definitely a few details about this that I wouldn't want to change, but I'm more than willing to edit most things so that this may fit the world even better, and to extend the story further, specialy as I gain a better understanding of how this universe works. Im also as ready to see my boy here thrive, flourish and acomplish all of his sweet little goals, as I am ready to watch him go trough the grinder and come out the other way an irrecognizeable mess and anything inbetween. Im open to whatever the overall story has ready for us!)
